problems: khanate-of-bukhara (another batch) needs the mirror of durrani-empire's 1768 contest_start/contest_end (Balkh, no land change), not a loss; the old 1768 gain from khanate-of-bukhara is gone.

qajar-dynasty (me-10) should record the 1796 conquest of Khorasan as a gain from Shahrokh Shah (Afsharid); durrani-empire no longer records a Nishapur 'loss' to the Qajar, it ends the Nishapur vassalage (confidence 1).

emirate-of-afghanistan (not touched, verdict thin) should now match durrani-dynasty at 1839-08 and 1843-04 (Kabul and Ghazni only; Kandahar excluded until 1855); the land of its 1839-08 loss and 1843-04 gain was not re-read here and should be checked by its next reader.

Quotes: two WebFetch reads of the Timur Shah Durrani page worded the Multan sentence differently; the earlier quote 'the Sikhs had taken Multan in 1772' was replaced with the wording of the verbatim read ('the Sikhs conquered Multan in 1772'). The Ahmad Shah Durrani page mentions the Amu Darya only as the river Shah Murad crossed; the border agreement is on the Durrani Empire page without a year.

Beyond the reviewer's list I also: removed Faryab (Maimana) from every durrani-empire keyframe 1752-1811, moved the Kalat and Sindh vassal ends from 1823 to 1818 (Principality of Kandahar page), split the durrani-dynasty founding so the Kandahar lands come from principality-of-kandahar, and set the durrani-dynasty 1840 and 1842 keyframes to verdict wrong with the 1839 land. The gazetteer_names_needed of the original report are unchanged; the repair needed no new names.
The reviewer's other verdicts (emirate-of-bukhara thin, emirate-of-afghanistan thin) were not touched, as instructed.
